title: ficus pseudobenjamina
intro: Ficus pseudobenjamina, commonly known as the Weeping Fig, is a species of fig tree native to Asia. It is known for its ability to purify the air and improve indoor air quality, providing health benefits such as reducing stress and anxiety, and improving respiratory function. The therapeutic actions of Ficus pseudobenjamina include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
